tasks.statement_en: The numbers 3 and -1 are roots of the polynomial $W(x)=2x^3+ax^2+bx+30$. a) Determine the values of the coefficients a and b. b) Calculate the third root of this polynomial.

The sum $S=\frac{3}{1\cdot4}+\frac{3}{4\cdot7}+\frac{3}{7\cdot10}+\dots+\frac{3}{301\cdot304}+\frac{3}{304\cdot307}$ can be computed as follows: a) we write $S$ as $S=\frac{4-1}{4\cdot1}+\frac{7-4}{7\cdot4}+\frac{10-7}{10\cdot7}+\dots+\frac{304-301}{304\cdot301}+\frac{307-304}{307\cdot304}$; b) we write each term as a difference of fractions: $S=\left(\frac{4}{4\cdot1}-\frac{1}{4\cdot1}\right)+\left(\frac{7}{7\cdot4}-\frac{4}{7\cdot4}\right)+\dots+\left(\frac{307}{307\cdot304}-\frac{304}{307\cdot304}\right)$, hence $S=\left(1-\frac14\right)+\left(\frac14-\frac17\right)+\left(\frac17-\frac1{10}\right)+\dots+\left(\frac1{301}-\frac1{304}\right)+\left(\frac1{304}-\frac1{307}\right)$; c) we compute the sum by cancelling adjacent terms in pairs, except the first and the last: $S=1-\frac{1}{307}=\frac{306}{307}$. Proceeding in an analogous way, calculate the sum $S_1=\frac{4}{1\cdot5}+\frac{4}{5\cdot9}+\frac{4}{9\cdot13}+\dots+\frac{4}{281\cdot285}$.
